Enum Class IconSpecsFab1

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<IconSpecsFab1>
org.patternfly.icon.IconSpecsFab1
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<IconSpecsFab1>, Constable
@Generated("generate.mjs") public enum IconSpecsFab1 extends Enum<IconSpecsFab1>
Icon specifications for Fontawesome brand icons.

You probably won't need to use this class directly, but instead work with IconSets.fab.

See Also:
  • https://www.patternfly.org/design-foundations/icons/
  • https://fontawesome.com/icons?d=galleryinvalid input: '&m'=free
